en: “Yeah, taking advantage of the nice weather.”
“Oh? Then you can take care of this side.”
Shizuku quietly picks up another bag of clean clothes and starts hanging them on the bamboo pole.
I feel like Shizuku is acting a bit unusual today, and occasionally catching her glancing my way.
It seems like she noticed me watching her.
The impact of our last interaction still lingers in my mind...
Shizuku keeps standing there, looking at me, making me suddenly feel a bit panicked.
“Uh... is there chocolate jello in the fridge?”
Shizuku trots off in front of me.
The awkward atmosphere just now leaves me unable to react...
Now that the task is done, I sit back on the porch again, enjoying my break.
The next second, Shizuku suddenly appears in front of me, holding a small spoon and chocolate jelly.
“Hurry up, and move back a bit!”
Shizuku urges me to open my thighs and move back.
Due to this motion, a small area opens up in front of me.
Then Shizuku turns around and sits right in front of me.
I can't quite grasp what this turmoil inside me is…
But I'm sure of two things. First, my heart is thumping wildly. I'm super nervous.
Second, Shizuku seems to be in the same boat, with her rosy ears visible beneath her silky white hair.
“Is this for the next part of the book?”
Ah... That's why she went to go get the jello.
To mask the awkwardness of the situation, she went to go get something to eat.
“As long as {Me} makes it… even if it's not chocolate, it's delicious.”
Is this really the same Shizuku?
I remember her being very... That's weird... I can't recall what she was like before…
I want to shout out loud… but I swallow it down.
Shizuku says this as she moves back, pressing her soft body tightly against me.
The scent and the feel of her fluffy hair stimulate my heart... and dick.
“How do you feel about being excited by your sister?”
“It's because you keep pressing against me...”
“No, I really like this side of you?”
I place my hand on Shizuku's head, gently stroking her soft hair.
“And besides, how can a stepbrother ignore his sister's needs?”
“I'll always be by your side, even if you don't like me.”
“I'll always be here to make you smile.”
It's weird to play this little game, but I'm sure it'll help Shizuku.
Shizuku's expression changes, and her gaze starts to drift.
“And I'm jealous of Ayano. I secretly hide her underwear...”
“Animals don't like me... They attack me when I get close...”
“And I have a very sensual body, so I secretly buy lots of toys...”
“And most importantly, I keep having unrealistic dreams...”
“Could you like me even if I'm like this?”
“I don't see anything wrong with any of that.”
“If you can't do all that... I can do it for you!”
“What's wrong with having dreams? I once dreamed of going to Mars.”
“You just keep smiling and do what you want. I'll handle the rest.”
After hearing me speak, Shizuku curls up tighter and closer to me.
Her uncertain expression turns into a rare, adorable smile.
If this continues, I might lose control and make a move on Shizuku.
I slowly wrap my arms around Shizuku, and instead of resisting, she snuggles even closer.
Hearing Kasumi's voice, we both quickly jump up.
“No, I mean—I'm helping {Me} with the laundry!”
“If you told me, I could have helped.”
“No, no, no! No need, I don't have much to do anyway!”
“Then I'll go back to my room and sleep!”
“I haven't seen Shizuku that happy in a long time.”
“She really is cuter when she smiles—right?”
“Nothing, it's just that Shizuko called. Can you take the call?”
What was I doing just now...
I must be blushing... I can't calm down...
